name: Levanto (Italy)
description: Blue field with a yellow horizontal stripe across the centre of the fly, and a white panel with a red Greek cross throughout at the hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Levanto, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: white panel with a red cross throughout at the hoist
